questions.question: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, what did He do?

answers.text: He headed back to the wilderness

questions.question: After Jesus left Nazareth, which town did He go to live in?
When Jesus told the fishermen Simon Peter and Andrew to follow Him, what did they do?

answers.text: They left their nets at once
They finished the day's catch first
They asked for time to think

questions.question: When Jesus called the brothers James and John, they left their boat and their father right away and followed Him.
